sentence: This project builds a machine learning tool that predicts water isotope patterns from climate variables in climate models.
This project studies how to design wireless networks and data analytics methods together so machine learning tasks run more efficiently.
This project builds a low cost robot that uses a large language model so behaviors come from verbal prompts instead of computer code.
This project builds a device that controls electrical and chemical signals to turn stem cells into patterned blood vessel networks.
This project studies how artificial intelligence and optimization can help make decisions in healthcare, transportation and manufacturing.
This project works to make voice AI recognize the speech of people who stutter.
This project uses single cell RNA sequencing and statistical tools to study how blood vessel cells change after spinal cord injury.
This project builds a cloud laboratory that uses artificial intelligence to guide experiments making thin-film materials.
This project builds mathematical models to study how the spatial shape of a population changes the way its evolution unfolds.
This project develops technologies to study genomes, including tools that trace cell lineage in animals and read the activity of transposons in maize.
This project teaches post-quantum cryptography, a way to protect systems from quantum attacks.
This project studies how the timing of flowering in sunflower plants interacts with climate and genes to affect yield.
This project uses brain imaging and artificial intelligence to study how the human brain controls thoughts and behaviors.
This project studies how a tunable solvent mixture helps break down waste plastic into building blocks for recycling.
This project builds security measures into engineered cells themselves to stop unwanted spread beyond a restricted environment.
This project builds a personalized learning system for robotics courses using low-cost hardware and simulators.
